why: pw_stream_get_time_n() is defined on an owned pw_stream and exposes graph ticks/delay plus queued/buffered timing state; the current read-only foreign-stream observer cannot manufacture that exact stream timeline for paplay.
One test-only timed playback driver solves both PREDECLARED_LATENCY_BOUND_CAUSALITY and CANCEL_SOURCE_TIMELINE_CAUSALITY without creating a second product playback authority.
The same mapped source position can deterministically select/prove an active old-audio cancel interval for CANCEL_ACTIVE_AUDIO_PROOF.
